title: EvaluatorInput
description: The image is what is under review. The text is the specification it is checked against: either a claim, or a question with its expected answer. Exactly one of the two.

data.description: Raw image bytes, base64-encoded; at most 10 MB decoded. SDK callers may pass bytes directly; this schema describes the wire shape.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the image.

claim.description: A claim about what the image shows, e.g. "The chart shows 12 apples."

question.description: The question the image accompanies. Requires `answer`.

answer.description: The expected answer to `question`. The two compose to `Question: "<question>" The answer is <answer>.`
